project_info.theme: Free World Cup viewing on TV360 for office workers with daily data plan
project_info.color_palette: Viettel red, white, black, wood brown, office gray, multicolor ribbon

main_subject.detail: Two young office men lean forward over a desk with surprised, excited faces while a large smartphone on the desk transforms into a miniature football field with tiny players. The main text says 'ANH EM VĂN PHÒNG' and 'XEM WORLD CUP MIỄN PHÍ TRÊN TV360'. At the bottom, a red promo box reads '12.000Đ/NGÀY —— 6GB' and 'SGVS12 gửi 191'.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square advertising poster for a Viettel office-focused World Cup viewing offer on TV360. Centerpiece is a photoreal fantasy scene of two excited office men leaning over a desk while a large smartphone transforms into a miniature football stadium with tiny players. Include the exact text 'ANH EM VĂN PHÒNG', 'XEM WORLD CUP MIỄN PHÍ TRÊN TV360', '12.000Đ/NGÀY —— 6GB', and 'SGVS12 gửi 191'. Background is a modern office desk environment with strong ad polish. Surrounding elements: Viettel telecom logo in the top left, multicolor ribbon beam from the top right, desk objects like pen holder, keyboard, earbuds, and a bold red offer card at the bottom left. Technical style: photoreal fantasy advertising composite, bright office commercial lighting, headline glow and crisp miniature field detail, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
